label: The Thomist combination: at the selected world some existing CONCRETE_6 thing is not spatiotemporal…
paraphrase: The Thomist combination: at the selected world some existing concrete thing is not spatiotemporal in the supplied sense. Analyst formulation: Aquinas says that God, angels and the intellectual soul are incorporeal (ST I q.3 a.1; q.50 a.1; q.75 a.2); reading incorporeal as not spatiotemporal is the analyst's bridge, and under the occupant sense presence by power does not count as occupation (DISAMB-SPATIOTEMPORAL).
